facts.fact: A Johns Hopkins and Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo evaluation in Toma district found limited integration between the REC-Maternity tablet tool and DHIS2, with parallel paper and electronic flows (REC-Maternity to DHIS2 record ratios of 1.56 for postnatal care and 3.05 for family planning in 2021) and facilities still summarising paper forms for district staff to enter into DHIS2; dated to the study's 2021 endline because the paper gives no later date.
